item.title: 83 neighbors bring Halloween to boy with autism on his birthday
item.description: ABC News' Danny New reports on an Alabama neighborhood that rallied to help a young boy with autism enjoy Halloween on his birthday.

item.description: NYC's emergency notification system warns of delays on Brooklyn-bound 4 and 6 trains.

item.title: Ukrainian drone strike on Russian warehouses in Moscow region kills 5

item.title: Leonardo DiCaprio, Jeff Bezos lead $200M project to save threatened species
item.description: Foundations backed by DiCaprio and Bezos have launched a $200 million initiative to revive 100 of the world's most endangered species.
